info.name: Banking Production Support Lab API
info.description:
## Banking Production Support Lab API

This collection supports **production monitoring and troubleshooting** for a banking transaction processing system. It provides a structured set of requests and saved examples that cover the full range of expected API behaviors — both successful outcomes and common error conditions — making it well-suited for support engineers diagnosing live issues.

### Endpoints Covered

- **Health Check** — Verifies the operational status of the API service, including a scenario where the service is down.
    
- **Get Transaction by ID** — Retrieves a single transaction by its numeric ID. Covers success, not-found (404), and invalid input type (e.g. passing a string instead of a number) scenarios.
    
- **Get Transaction by RRN** — Retrieves a transaction using its Retrieval Reference Number (RRN). Covers success and not-found scenarios.
    
- **Get All Transactions by Terminal** — Fetches all transactions associated with a specific terminal ID. Covers success and not-found scenarios.
    
- **Post Transaction** — Submits a new transaction. Covers a successful submission as well as validation failure cases: invalid PAN, invalid currency code, and missing required fields.
    

### Usage

All requests are parameterized using the `{{base_url}}` environment variable. Set this variable in the active environment (e.g. **Local**) to point to the target server before running any requests.
